item.title: Bulletin updated at 08:00 HKT 28/Apr/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will continue to bring showers and thunderstorms to Guangdong today. With the trough of low pressure weakening, it will be brighter over the region on Monday. Another trough of low pressure is expected to form over the northern part of southern China and edge closer to the coast of southern China midweek this week. Meanwhile, an easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong, the weather will be unsettled with thundery showers over the region. With an anticyclone aloft strengthening, the weather will improve gradually over the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week.

Date/Month: 28/04 (Sunday)
Wind: East force 5, force 6 offshore and on high ground at first. Southeast force 4 later.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with occasional showers and a few squally thunderstorms. Showers will gradually ease off later.

R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium High
